blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Sandiganbayan Fifth Division has rejected Sen. Jinggoy Estrada’s appeal to lift his 90-day preventive suspension over a plunder case involving alleged P573 million kickbacks from government infrastructure projects. In a resolution promulgated on Nov. 10, the antigraft court denied Estrada’s motion for reconsideration, ruling that it had no merit. Estrada filed the motion on Oct. 19, a week after the Fifth Division ordered his suspension in a resolution dated Oct. 12.
